purpose: Teach: 前作/反復/ハードル/ベタ/アンコール/アウトドア/大晦日/ぶどう

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、好きなゲームの、絶対、前作、絶対、やった?本気で
lines.en: Riku — did you actually play the previous game in your favorite series? I'm serious.
lines.style: Playful accusation with genuine curiosity underneath. Leans forward slightly. Quick rhythm, eager to hear the answer. A little teasing on the 'actually.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、反復、絶対、練習、絶対、すげえな、桜
lines.en: You practice the exact same thing over and over — it's kind of amazing, Sakura.
lines.style: Sincere observation delivered with a half-smile. Steady, unrushed. Genuine appreciation without making it a big deal. Slight warmth creeping in at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、ハードル、絶対、高すぎるよ
lines.en: Riku, your standards are way too high for me.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware laugh underneath. Slow delivery on 'too high.' Slight shoulder shrug in the voice. Not defensive — just stating a fact she finds amusing about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお話、本気で、絶対、ベタ、絶対、すぎるぜ、桜
lines.en: Your stories are always the same old thing, Sakura.
lines.style: Light, teasing jab. Quick tempo. A smile audible in the voice — not mean-spirited, just honest in that way close friends are. Eyes twinkling even if she can't see it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ライブの、本気で、絶対、アンコール、絶対、最高だったね
lines.en: Riku, that encore at the live was seriously the best.
lines.style: Animated and genuine. Energy lifted slightly. Speaking faster than before. Real excitement — not performed. The 'seriously' lands with weight because she actually means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、アウトドア、絶対、好きだよな、桜
lines.en: You really do love being outdoors, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Observation wrapped in a question. Warm, knowing tone. Not quite teasing, more like he's caught onto something about her. Gentle curiosity. Half-smile audible.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、大晦日、絶対、何してた?本気で
lines.en: Riku — what were you doing on New Year's Eve? Seriously.
lines.style: Direct, curious lean-in. Faster tempo than the last line. Genuine question underneath the casual phrasing. The second 'seriously' is a gentle nudge, not pressure.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお母さんの、本気で、絶対、ぶどう、絶対、ジュース、絶対、ウマかったぜ、桜
lines.en: Your mom's grape juice was seriously delicious, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm, genuine compliment with a touch of shy affection. Slower pace. Settles into the memory for just a moment. Soft, sincere — the kind of thing he'd almost not say to her face.
